title: Scene Library Diagnostics tab and runtime telemetry

phases.title: Add read-only scene diagnostics and green-artifact suspect telemetry
Add the Scene Library Diagnostics tab, controls, telemetry presentation, and styling

finalChecks.name: Diagnostics tab wired
finalChecks.run: grep -q 'showDiagnostics' scripts/scene-library.mjs && grep -q 'Scene Library Diagnostics' templates/scene-library.hbs

finalChecks.name: Green artifact probe telemetry present
finalChecks.run: grep -q 'greenArtifactCandidates' scripts/scene-library.mjs && grep -q 'Green artifact probe' templates/scene-library.hbs

finalChecks.name: Manifest version
finalChecks.run: node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('module.json','utf8')); if(m.version!=='0.3.8') throw new Error('expected module 0.3.8');"
